title: Blue & Red Floral Hand Block Print Sleeveless Cotton Kurta Set with Kota Doria Dupatta
color_custom: Cornflower blue with bold red florals, ivory & blue printed pants
description:
Bold, bright and made for warm days – a cornflower blue cotton kurta covered in big red hand block printed blooms with a delicate vine pattern. The square neckline and sleeveless cut keep it cool, a printed border finishes the hem, and the ivory pants carry a small blue and mustard buti. The kota doria dupatta brings it all together with a blue buti body and a rich red kalamkari-style border with tassels.

✦ The Details
• Straight sleeveless cotton kurta with a square neckline and side slits, calf length
• Large hand block printed red florals on a blue base
• Printed border at the hem
• Ivory cotton pants with a blue and mustard hand block buti
• Kota doria dupatta with blue buti, red floral border and tassels
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
The kurta and pants are soft, breathable cotton, printed by hand with carved wooden blocks by karigars in Sanganer, Jaipur – one colour and one block at a time. The dupatta is kota doria, a featherlight handloom fabric from Rajasthan with its signature checked (khat) weave, also hand block printed. Small shifts and variations in the print are the mark of real handwork, not a defect.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, straight fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements at no extra cost.

✦ How to Style It
Oxidised silver jhumkas and a stack of bangles for a festive day. Flat sandals and sunglasses for a holiday or a summer market. Add a white or denim shirt over the kurta for the office.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Indigo dyes may release a little colour in the first few washes – wash separately in cold water. The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Sleeveless Straight Kurta (cotton, hand block print)
Dupatta (kota doria, hand block print, tassels)
care: Gentle hand wash separately in cold water with mild soap. Do not soak or wring. Dry inside-out in shade. Iron on medium heat from the reverse. Kota dupatta: dry clean or gentle hand wash.
